🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Amidst simmering tensions, India-Bangladesh consular dialogue postponed

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 07:07:59 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: This would have been the fifth such consular dialogue and the first after the August 2024 uprising; postponement due to tensions over former PM Hasina’s plan to return to Bangladesh next month

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Days after Bangladesh’s deposed Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina requested Dhaka for a new passport and national identity card, the fifth India-Bangladesh consular dialogue that was scheduled to take place on November 17 and 18 has been postponed, a diplomatic source has confirmed. The source indicated that the postponement of the dialogue was mainly on account of growing tensions in the bilateral relationship caused by Ms. Hasina’s announcement that she will return to Bangladesh next month. The planned consular dialogue would have been the first such meeting between the two sides in more than two years. The last such dialogue was held in New Delhi on May 29, 2024, just over two months before the Hasina government fell in a youth-led uprising in Dhaka. The consular dialogue was scheduled to be held in Dhaka at the level of Director Generals of the Foreign Ministries of both countries. The planned agenda included issues of border management, visa procedures, and the repatriation of citizens detained on both sides. The number of Indian visas issued was drastically reduced when tensions broke out in August 2024. According to sources, India has gradually increased the number of visas issued to travellers from Bangladesh in recent months, especially after the election of Prime Minister Tarique Rahman in February this year. The two countries started a consular dialogue in 2017 to “strengthen people-to-people contacts by having a regular channel of communication on consular, visa, and mutual legal assistance cooperation matters between India and Bangladesh.” Four rounds of consular dialogues were held during the rule of the Awami League in Dhaka. As per the Ministry of External Affairs, the fourth round held in May 2024 discussed issues like “visa matters, repatriation, Mutual Legal Assistance Treaty cases etc.” Attempts at normalising the India-Bangladesh relationship in recent months have been hindered by Ms. Hasina’s presence in India, where she took refuge on August 5, 2024. On November 9 this year, a London-based legal firm representing Ms. Hasina wrote to the High Commission of Bangladesh in New Delhi requesting a new passport and the national ID card. “In view of the reported revocation of her existing Bangladeshi passport and National Identity Card (NID) by the Interim Government and other authorities, I respectfully request that you take the necessary steps to issue a new Bangladeshi passport and National Identity Card for our client,” said the letter sent by the law firm Matrix Chambers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: However, the Acting Foreign Minister of Bangladesh Humayun Kabir responded to this development by telling journalists that Bangladesh would not issue a passport to Ms. Hasina. Instead, he said, Dhaka would seek Ms. Hasina’s extradition under an “acceptable prisoner exchange process”, adding that such a handover would have to be conducted carefully and under proper surveillance.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Bilateral (Adjective)
द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।
✓ Syn: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way
Communication (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Communication' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Postponement (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Postponement' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Amidst simmering tensions, India-Bangladesh consular dialogue postponed", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. This would have been the fifth such consular dialogue and the first after the August 2024 uprising; postponement due to tensions over former PM...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Amidst simmering tensions, India-Bangladesh cons' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Amidst simmering tensions, India-Bangladesh c' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Amidst simmering tensions, India-Bangladesh c' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "This would have been the fifth such consular dialogue and the first after the August 2024 uprising; postponement due to tensions over former PM..." (Hinglish Arth: यह पांचवीं ऐसी कांसुलर वार्ता होती और अगस्त 2024 के विद्रोह के बाद पहली; पूर्व पीएम हसीना की अगले महीने बांग्लादेश लौटने की योजना पर तनाव के कारण स्थगन)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Amidst simmering tensions, India-Bangladesh consular dialogue postponed"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Hasina’s extradition under an “acceptable prisoner exchange process”, adding that such a handover would have to be conducted carefully and under...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Hasina’s extradition under an “acceptable prisoner exchange process”, adding that such a handover would have to be conducted carefully and under..." (Hinglish Arth: हसीना का प्रत्यर्पण "स्वीकार्य कैदी विनिमय प्रक्रिया" के तहत किया जाना चाहिए, यह कहते हुए कि इस तरह के प्रत्यर्पण को सावधानीपूर्वक और उचित निगरानी में किया जाना चाहिए।)

articles.title: Industry seeks LTCG, STT cuts in Budget 2027; MSME relief also on wish list
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Several industry bodies have been meeting top officials of the Finance Ministry as part of the annual pre-Budget consultation process

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Several industry bodies have recommended to the Ministry of Finance that the upcoming Budget 2027 should rationalise the Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax rate on equities and reduce the rate of the Securities Transaction Tax (STT). Officials in the Finance Ministry, including Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman and Revenue Secretary Arvind Shrivastava, have been conducting their pre-Budget consultative meetings, during which they met the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII), Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI), the PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PHDCCI), and the Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry (ASSOCHAM), among others. One of the most-cited requests from the industry was the rationalisation of LTCG on equities. In Budget 2026, the Centre removed the 12.5% LTCG tax in the government securities market for foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) alongside other measures including reforms under the Fully Accessible Route (FAR). Currently, foreign and domestic investors have to pay 12.5% tax on the sale of equities on gains exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh per annum on listed shares. The Centre has held several meetings with the Securities and Exchange Board of India, the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) and other industry players. “Removing the LTCG levy would raise post-tax returns and close a gap with Korea, Taiwan and Brazil,” Rakesh Nangia, chairman of task force on International Taxes at ASSOCHAM said. “The debt market is a useful precedent, which after the G-sec relief, saw FPI inflows rise to about $9 billion in June-July.” The PHDCCI has requested that the government abolish LTCG tax on equity investments, reduce the short-term capital gains (STCG) tax rate from 20% to 10%, and lower STT rates “to encourage long-term investment and improve India’s capital market competitiveness”. In its representation to Ms. Sitharaman, FICCI highlighted the fact that foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) have withdrawn about Rs 3.08 lakh crore during the year. It added that capital gains tax, which is charged over and above the STT, erodes returns from equities, and needs a review to make India a more attractive place to invest. However, other market players highlight that the revenue loss incurred from the removal of LTCG could be negated through a hike in STT. According to estimates by SBI Research, the removal of LTCG would result in a revenue loss of Rs 40,000-50,000 crore for FY28. One of the key frictions for FPIs underscored by industry bodies and equity analysts is the computation of the tax. Under Income-Tax Act, the calculation of the LTCG is in the Indian rupee. The challenge arises due to currency depreciation as against the investor’s base currency during the holding period, due to which investors are still liable to pay tax even when net returns in dollar terms are flat or even negative. This issue is currently under examination.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: VK Vijayakumar, chief investment strategist at Geojit Financial Services also cautioned against selective relief, noting that abolishing LTCG solely for FPIs would be discriminatory against domestic retail and direct equity investors who remain subject to the 12.5% tax. He urged any tax relief must apply equally across the board to ensure a level playing field.

hinglishTracks.en: Several industry bodies have been meeting top officials of the Finance Ministry as part of the annual pre-Budget consultation process
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — कई उद्योग निकाय वार्षिक बजट पूर्व परामर्श प्रक्रिया के हिस्से के रूप में वित्त मंत्रालय के शीर्ष अधिकारियों से मुलाकात कर रहे हैं।

hinglishTracks.en: Several industry bodies have recommended to the Ministry of Finance that the upcoming Budget 2027 should rationalise the Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax rate on equities and reduce the rate of the Securities Transaction Tax (STT).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कई उद्योग निकायों ने वित्त मंत्रालय से सिफारिश की है कि आगामी बजट 2027 में इक्विटी पर दीर्घकालिक पूंजीगत लाभ (एलटीसीजी) कर की दर को तर्कसंगत बनाया जाना चाहिए और प्रतिभूति लेनदेन कर (एसटीटी) की दर को कम किया जाना चाहिए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Rationalisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: युक्तिकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Rationalisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Officials in the Finance Ministry, including Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman and Revenue Secretary Arvind Shrivastava, have been conducting their pre-Budget consultative meetings, during which they met the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII), Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI), the PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PHDCCI), and the Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry (ASSOCHAM), among others.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — वित्त मंत्री निर्मला सीतारमण और राजस्व सचिव अरविंद श्रीवास्तव सहित वित्त मंत्रालय के अधिकारी अपनी बजट पूर्व परामर्श बैठकें कर रहे हैं, जिसके दौरान उन्होंने भारतीय उद्योग परिसंघ (सीआईआई), फेडरेशन ऑफ इंडियन चैंबर्स ऑफ कॉमर्स एंड इंडस्ट्री (फिक्की), पीएचडी चैंबर ऑफ कॉमर्स एंड इंडस्ट्री (पीएचडीसीसीआई), और एसोसिएटेड चैंबर्स ऑफ कॉमर्स एंड इंडस्ट्री (एसोचैम) से मुलाकात की।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Rationalisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: युक्तिकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Rationalisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: One of the most-cited requests from the industry was the rationalisation of LTCG on equities.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — उद्योग जगत की ओर से सबसे अधिक उद्धृत अनुरोधों में से एक इक्विटी पर एलटीसीजी को युक्तिसंगत बनाना था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Rationalisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: युक्तिकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Rationalisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: In Budget 2026, the Centre removed the 12.5% LTCG tax in the government securities market for foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) alongside other measures including reforms under the Fully Accessible Route (FAR).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — बजट 2026 में, केंद्र ने फुली एक्सेसिबल रूट (एफएआर) के तहत सुधारों सहित अन्य उपायों के साथ-साथ विदेशी पोर्टफोलियो निवेशकों (एफपीआई) के लिए सरकारी प्रतिभूति बाजार में 12.5% ​​एलटीसीजी कर हटा दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Currently, foreign and domestic investors have to pay 12.5% tax on the sale of equities on gains exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh per annum on listed shares.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — वर्तमान में, विदेशी और घरेलू निवेशकों को सूचीबद्ध शेयरों पर प्रति वर्ष 1.25 लाख रुपये से अधिक के लाभ पर इक्विटी की बिक्री पर 12.5% ​​कर का भुगतान करना पड़ता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Centre has held several meetings with the Securities and Exchange Board of India, the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) and other industry players.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — केंद्र ने भारतीय प्रतिभूति और विनिमय बोर्ड, केंद्रीय प्रत्यक्ष कर बोर्ड (सीबीडीटी) और अन्य उद्योग के खिलाड़ियों के साथ कई बैठकें की हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Removing the LTCG levy would raise post-tax returns and close a gap with Korea, Taiwan and Brazil,” Rakesh Nangia, chairman of task force on International Taxes at ASSOCHAM said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — एसोचैम में अंतर्राष्ट्रीय करों पर टास्क फोर्स के अध्यक्ष राकेश नांगिया ने कहा, "एलटीसीजी लेवी हटाने से कर-पश्चात रिटर्न बढ़ेगा और कोरिया, ताइवान और ब्राजील के साथ अंतर कम होगा।"। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अंतरराष्ट्रीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'International' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: “The debt market is a useful precedent, which after the G-sec relief, saw FPI inflows rise to about $9 billion in June-July.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — "ऋण बाजार एक उपयोगी मिसाल है, जिसमें जी-सेक राहत के बाद जून-जुलाई में एफपीआई प्रवाह बढ़कर लगभग 9 बिलियन डॉलर हो गया।"।

hinglishTracks.en: The PHDCCI has requested that the government abolish LTCG tax on equity investments, reduce the short-term capital gains (STCG) tax rate from 20% to 10%, and lower STT rates “to encourage long-term investment and improve India’s capital market competitiveness”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — पीएचडीसीसीआई ने अनुरोध किया है कि सरकार इक्विटी निवेश पर एलटीसीजी कर को समाप्त कर दे, अल्पकालिक पूंजीगत लाभ (एसटीसीजी) कर की दर को 20% से घटाकर 10% कर दे, और "दीर्घकालिक निवेश को प्रोत्साहित करने और भारत की पूंजी बाजार प्रतिस्पर्धा में सुधार करने के लिए" एसटीटी दरों को कम कर दे।।

hinglishTracks.en: In its representation to Ms.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — सुश्री को अपने अभ्यावेदन में। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Representation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रतिनिधित्व — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Representation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Sitharaman, FICCI highlighted the fact that foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) have withdrawn about Rs 3.08 lakh crore during the year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सीतारमण, फिक्की ने इस तथ्य पर प्रकाश डाला कि विदेशी पोर्टफोलियो निवेशकों (एफपीआई) ने वर्ष के दौरान लगभग 3.08 लाख करोड़ रुपये निकाले हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: It added that capital gains tax, which is charged over and above the STT, erodes returns from equities, and needs a review to make India a more attractive place to invest.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इसमें कहा गया है कि पूंजीगत लाभ कर, जो एसटीटी से अधिक लिया जाता है, इक्विटी से रिटर्न को खत्म कर देता है, और भारत को निवेश के लिए अधिक आकर्षक स्थान बनाने के लिए समीक्षा की आवश्यकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: However, other market players highlight that the revenue loss incurred from the removal of LTCG could be negated through a hike in STT.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हालाँकि, अन्य बाज़ार खिलाड़ी इस बात पर प्रकाश डालते हैं कि एलटीसीजी को हटाने से होने वाले राजस्व नुकसान को एसटीटी में बढ़ोतरी के माध्यम से कम किया जा सकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: According to estimates by SBI Research, the removal of LTCG would result in a revenue loss of Rs 40,000-50,000 crore for FY28.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एसबीआई रिसर्च के अनुमान के मुताबिक, एलटीसीजी हटाने से वित्त वर्ष 2028 में 40,000-50,000 करोड़ रुपये का राजस्व घाटा होगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: One of the key frictions for FPIs underscored by industry bodies and equity analysts is the computation of the tax.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उद्योग निकायों और इक्विटी विश्लेषकों द्वारा रेखांकित एफपीआई के लिए प्रमुख उलझनों में से एक कर की गणना है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Under Income-Tax Act, the calculation of the LTCG is in the Indian rupee.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — आयकर अधिनियम के तहत एलटीसीजी की गणना भारतीय रुपये में होती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The challenge arises due to currency depreciation as against the investor’s base currency during the holding period, due to which investors are still liable to pay tax even when net returns in dollar terms are flat or even negative.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — होल्डिंग अवधि के दौरान निवेशक की आधार मुद्रा की तुलना में मुद्रा के अवमूल्यन के कारण चुनौती उत्पन्न होती है, जिसके कारण डॉलर के संदर्भ में शुद्ध रिटर्न सपाट या नकारात्मक होने पर भी निवेशकों को कर का भुगतान करना पड़ता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: This issue is currently under examination.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #18 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Industry seeks LTCG, STT cuts in Budget 2027; MSME relief also on wish list

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 09:31:15 AM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Several industry bodies have been meeting top officials of the Finance Ministry as part of the annual pre-Budget consultation process

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Several industry bodies have recommended to the Ministry of Finance that the upcoming Budget 2027 should rationalise the Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax rate on equities and reduce the rate of the Securities Transaction Tax (STT). Officials in the Finance Ministry, including Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman and Revenue Secretary Arvind Shrivastava, have been conducting their pre-Budget consultative meetings, during which they met the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII), Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI), the PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PHDCCI), and the Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry (ASSOCHAM), among others. One of the most-cited requests from the industry was the rationalisation of LTCG on equities. In Budget 2026, the Centre removed the 12.5% LTCG tax in the government securities market for foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) alongside other measures including reforms under the Fully Accessible Route (FAR). Currently, foreign and domestic investors have to pay 12.5% tax on the sale of equities on gains exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh per annum on listed shares. The Centre has held several meetings with the Securities and Exchange Board of India, the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) and other industry players. “Removing the LTCG levy would raise post-tax returns and close a gap with Korea, Taiwan and Brazil,” Rakesh Nangia, chairman of task force on International Taxes at ASSOCHAM said. “The debt market is a useful precedent, which after the G-sec relief, saw FPI inflows rise to about $9 billion in June-July.” The PHDCCI has requested that the government abolish LTCG tax on equity investments, reduce the short-term capital gains (STCG) tax rate from 20% to 10%, and lower STT rates “to encourage long-term investment and improve India’s capital market competitiveness”. In its representation to Ms. Sitharaman, FICCI highlighted the fact that foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) have withdrawn about Rs 3.08 lakh crore during the year. It added that capital gains tax, which is charged over and above the STT, erodes returns from equities, and needs a review to make India a more attractive place to invest. However, other market players highlight that the revenue loss incurred from the removal of LTCG could be negated through a hike in STT. According to estimates by SBI Research, the removal of LTCG would result in a revenue loss of Rs 40,000-50,000 crore for FY28. One of the key frictions for FPIs underscored by industry bodies and equity analysts is the computation of the tax. Under Income-Tax Act, the calculation of the LTCG is in the Indian rupee. The challenge arises due to currency depreciation as against the investor’s base currency during the holding period, due to which investors are still liable to pay tax even when net returns in dollar terms are flat or even negative. This issue is currently under examination.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: VK Vijayakumar, chief investment strategist at Geojit Financial Services also cautioned against selective relief, noting that abolishing LTCG solely for FPIs would be discriminatory against domestic retail and direct equity investors who remain subject to the 12.5% tax. He urged any tax relief must apply equally across the board to ensure a level playing field.

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "Industry seeks LTCG, STT cuts in Budget 2027; MSME relief also on wish list", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Several industry bodies have been meeting top officials of the Finance Ministry as part of the annual pre-Budget consultation process.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Industry seeks LTCG, STT cuts in Budget 2027; MS' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Industry seeks LTCG, STT cuts in Budget 2027;' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Industry seeks LTCG, STT cuts in Budget 2027;' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Several industry bodies have been meeting top officials of the Finance Ministry as part of the annual pre-Budget consultation process." (Hinglish Arth: कई उद्योग निकाय वार्षिक बजट पूर्व परामर्श प्रक्रिया के हिस्से के रूप में वित्त मंत्रालय के शीर्ष अधिकारियों से मुलाकात कर रहे हैं)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Industry seeks LTCG, STT cuts in Budget 2027; MSME relief also on wish list"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. He urged any tax relief must apply equally across the board to ensure a level playing field.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "He urged any tax relief must apply equally across the board to ensure a level playing field." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने आग्रह किया कि समान अवसर सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कोई भी कर राहत सभी बोर्ड में समान रूप से लागू होनी चाहिए।)

articles.title: Former Nvidia CEO Huang had a relationship with a second employee, sources say
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The two women so far are Alice Huang, who U.S. ‌intelligence suspects of being a Chinese spy, and Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health ‌care

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an ‌ intimate relationship with a second employee, according to ​two people familiar with the matter, Reuters has ⁠learned. The revelation follows two other extramarital affairs that led to his resignation Thursday. The two women are Alice Huang, who U.S. ‌intelligence suspects of being a Chinese spy, and Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health ‌care. Reuters is not naming the second employee. Attempts ‌to ⁠reach the woman were not successful. ALSO WATCH Watch: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO amid affair with alleged Chinese spy | Above the Fold | Nov 12, 2026 Nvidia declined to ⁠comment. Powell, Jensen Huang, and a representative for Nvidia’s board did not reply to requests for comment. Alice Huang could not be reached ​for comment. Jensen Huang ‌admitted to an affair in a November 8 statement following the reports of his relationship with Alice Huang, without referring to her by name. The former Nvidia CEO’s ‌decision to resign from the company could disrupt ​the AI industry that he helped shape. Nvidia has used its financial strength to help ⁠create an industry around AI through complex financial arrangements that ease the purchase of the company’s chips. It has backed ‌cloud computing companies and AI labs in order to do so. Pressure on Jensen Huang, who is 63 and married, to resign mounted after reports of his affair with Alice Huang. Nvidia’s board appointed finance chief Colette Kress as interim CEO while it conducts a search ‌to replace Jensen Huang. The board is considering internal and external ​candidates for the job.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Earlier this month, Nvidia’s board launched a probe, led by independent directors with outside ⁠legal counsel, into whether Jensen Huang had been targeted by ⁠a foreign intelligence operation. It also expressed confidence in him at the time.

📰 Former Nvidia CEO Huang had a relationship with a second employee, sources say

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 10:14:57 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The two women so far are Alice Huang, who U.S. ‌intelligence suspects of being a Chinese spy, and Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health ‌care

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an ‌ intimate relationship with a second employee, according to ​two people familiar with the matter, Reuters has ⁠learned. The revelation follows two other extramarital affairs that led to his resignation Thursday. The two women are Alice Huang, who U.S. ‌intelligence suspects of being a Chinese spy, and Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health ‌care. Reuters is not naming the second employee. Attempts ‌to ⁠reach the woman were not successful. ALSO WATCH Watch: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO amid affair with alleged Chinese spy | Above the Fold | Nov 12, 2026 Nvidia declined to ⁠comment. Powell, Jensen Huang, and a representative for Nvidia’s board did not reply to requests for comment. Alice Huang could not be reached ​for comment. Jensen Huang ‌admitted to an affair in a November 8 statement following the reports of his relationship with Alice Huang, without referring to her by name. The former Nvidia CEO’s ‌decision to resign from the company could disrupt ​the AI industry that he helped shape. Nvidia has used its financial strength to help ⁠create an industry around AI through complex financial arrangements that ease the purchase of the company’s chips. It has backed ‌cloud computing companies and AI labs in order to do so. Pressure on Jensen Huang, who is 63 and married, to resign mounted after reports of his affair with Alice Huang. Nvidia’s board appointed finance chief Colette Kress as interim CEO while it conducts a search ‌to replace Jensen Huang. The board is considering internal and external ​candidates for the job.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Earlier this month, Nvidia’s board launched a probe, led by independent directors with outside ⁠legal counsel, into whether Jensen Huang had been targeted by ⁠a foreign intelligence operation. It also expressed confidence in him at the time.

articles.title: UN climate summit pushes electrification goal as groups call for mining safeguards

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The pledge builds on commitments made at previous UN climate summits: At COP28, countries agreed to work toward tripling renewable energy capacity and transitioning away from fossil fuels. COP29 focused on energy storage, grid modernisation and climate finance

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Clean public transport, energy-efficient buildings and affordable energy are a few of the things the president of the UN climate talks — known as COP31 — asked global leaders and climate activists to pledge as part of the global electrification plan laid out during the world's largest annual climate summit. But environmental and human rights organisations caution that without strong safeguards, the mining boom for the minerals and metals needed to make the power lines, batteries, wind turbines and other energy infrastructure that can make the pledge a reality could have serious environmental and human rights impacts across the globe. Mining has come at a cost to communities and habitats around the globe: Forests have been felled, water supplies poisoned and Indigenous peoples have lost access to land. Rights groups have urged COP31 officials to focus on how to fairly source the materials needed for the transition. Turkiye announced that electrification would be one of the main priorities during its copresidency of COP31 with Australia. The “35-by-35” global electrification pledge aims to increase the use of electricity from 21% to 35% by 2035 to reduce planet-warming greenhouse emissions, preferably from renewable energy such as solar and wind. The pledge builds on commitments made at previous UN climate summits: At COP28 , countries agreed to work toward tripling renewable energy capacity and transitioning away from fossil fuels. COP29 focused on energy storage, grid modernisation and climate finance. The COP31 presidency said electrification is the next logical step, translating earlier pledges into changes in how energy is consumed. “This transition brings together renewable energy, strong grids, storage capacity, energy efficiency, clean transport and green industry. Each supports the others,” said COP31 president Murat Kurum, who is also Turkiye's environment minister. “We want people to feel the results of climate talks in daily life: in buildings that use less energy, in clean public transport, in energy they can afford and in new jobs.” Environmental activists note that the pledge does not require that electricity must come from renewable sources, meaning coal and other fossil fuels could be used. But as countries try to move away from fossil fuels, renewable energy is expected to play a major role.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: From Indonesia to Brazil, the boom in demand for the metals and minerals needed to create wind turbines, solar panels, electric vehicle batteries, high-speed railways and other technologies crucial for the renewable energy transition has been underway for some time, according to the International Energy Agency.

Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: From Indonesia to Brazil, the boom in demand for the metals and minerals needed to create wind turbines, solar panels, electric vehicle batteries, high-speed railways and other technologies crucial for the renewable energy transition has been underway for some time, according to the International Energy Agency.

hinglishTracks.en: The pledge builds on commitments made at previous UN climate summits: At COP28, countries agreed to work toward tripling renewable energy capacity and transitioning away from fossil fuels.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह प्रतिज्ञा पिछले संयुक्त राष्ट्र जलवायु शिखर सम्मेलन में की गई प्रतिबद्धताओं पर आधारित है: COP28 में, देशों ने नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा क्षमता को तीन गुना करने और जीवाश्म ईंधन से दूर जाने की दिशा में काम करने पर सहमति व्यक्त की।।

hinglishTracks.en: COP29 focused on energy storage, grid modernisation and climate finance
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — COP29 ऊर्जा भंडारण, ग्रिड आधुनिकीकरण और जलवायु वित्त पर केंद्रित है। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Modernisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: आधुनिकीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Modernisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Clean public transport, energy-efficient buildings and affordable energy are a few of the things the president of the UN climate talks — known as COP31 — asked global leaders and climate activists to pledge as part of the global electrification plan laid out during the world's largest annual climate summit.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — स्वच्छ सार्वजनिक परिवहन, ऊर्जा-कुशल इमारतें और सस्ती ऊर्जा कुछ ऐसी चीजें हैं जिन्हें संयुक्त राष्ट्र जलवायु वार्ता के अध्यक्ष - जिसे COP31 के रूप में जाना जाता है - ने वैश्विक नेताओं और जलवायु कार्यकर्ताओं से दुनिया के सबसे बड़े वार्षिक जलवायु शिखर सम्मेलन के दौरान निर्धारित वैश्विक विद्युतीकरण योजना के हिस्से के रूप में प्रतिज्ञा करने के लिए कहा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Electrification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: विद्युतीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Electrification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: But environmental and human rights organisations caution that without strong safeguards, the mining boom for the minerals and metals needed to make the power lines, batteries, wind turbines and other energy infrastructure that can make the pledge a reality could have serious environmental and human rights impacts across the globe.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लेकिन पर्यावरण और मानवाधिकार संगठनों ने चेतावनी दी है कि मजबूत सुरक्षा उपायों के बिना, बिजली लाइनों, बैटरी, पवन टरबाइन और अन्य ऊर्जा बुनियादी ढांचे को बनाने के लिए आवश्यक खनिजों और धातुओं के खनन में तेजी, जो प्रतिज्ञा को वास्तविकता बना सकती है, दुनिया भर में गंभीर पर्यावरणीय और मानवाधिकार प्रभाव डाल सकती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: Mining has come at a cost to communities and habitats around the globe: Forests have been felled, water supplies poisoned and Indigenous peoples have lost access to land.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — खनन के कारण दुनिया भर में समुदायों और आवासों को नुकसान उठाना पड़ा है: जंगलों को काट दिया गया है, पानी की आपूर्ति जहरीली हो गई है और स्वदेशी लोगों की भूमि तक पहुंच खत्म हो गई है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Indigenous' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: स्वदेशी — अपने ही देश (भारत) के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों द्वारा देश में विकसित किया गया। इसके Synonyms हैं: Domestic, Home-grown, Native और Antonyms हैं: Imported, Foreign, Exotic।

hinglishTracks.en: Rights groups have urged COP31 officials to focus on how to fairly source the materials needed for the transition.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अधिकार समूहों ने COP31 अधिकारियों से इस बात पर ध्यान केंद्रित करने का आग्रह किया है कि संक्रमण के लिए आवश्यक सामग्रियों को उचित तरीके से कैसे प्राप्त किया जाए।।

hinglishTracks.en: Turkiye announced that electrification would be one of the main priorities during its copresidency of COP31 with Australia.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — तुर्किये ने घोषणा की कि ऑस्ट्रेलिया के साथ COP31 की सह-अध्यक्षता के दौरान विद्युतीकरण मुख्य प्राथमिकताओं में से एक होगा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Electrification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: विद्युतीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Electrification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The “35-by-35” global electrification pledge aims to increase the use of electricity from 21% to 35% by 2035 to reduce planet-warming greenhouse emissions, preferably from renewable energy such as solar and wind.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — "35-बाई-35" वैश्विक विद्युतीकरण प्रतिज्ञा का लक्ष्य ग्रह-वार्मिंग ग्रीनहाउस उत्सर्जन को कम करने के लिए 2035 तक बिजली के उपयोग को 21% से बढ़ाकर 35% करना है, विशेष रूप से सौर और पवन जैसी नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा से।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Electrification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: विद्युतीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Electrification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The pledge builds on commitments made at previous UN climate summits: At COP28 , countries agreed to work toward tripling renewable energy capacity and transitioning away from fossil fuels.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह प्रतिज्ञा पिछले संयुक्त राष्ट्र जलवायु शिखर सम्मेलन में की गई प्रतिबद्धताओं पर आधारित है: COP28 में, देशों ने नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा क्षमता को तीन गुना करने और जीवाश्म ईंधन से दूर जाने की दिशा में काम करने पर सहमति व्यक्त की।।

hinglishTracks.en: COP29 focused on energy storage, grid modernisation and climate finance.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — COP29 ऊर्जा भंडारण, ग्रिड आधुनिकीकरण और जलवायु वित्त पर केंद्रित है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Modernisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: आधुनिकीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Modernisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The COP31 presidency said electrification is the next logical step, translating earlier pledges into changes in how energy is consumed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — COP31 प्रेसीडेंसी ने कहा कि विद्युतीकरण अगला तार्किक कदम है, जो पहले की प्रतिज्ञाओं को ऊर्जा की खपत के तरीके में बदलाव में तब्दील करता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Electrification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: विद्युतीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Electrification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: “This transition brings together renewable energy, strong grids, storage capacity, energy efficiency, clean transport and green industry.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “यह परिवर्तन नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा, मजबूत ग्रिड, भंडारण क्षमता, ऊर्जा दक्षता, स्वच्छ परिवहन और हरित उद्योग को एक साथ लाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Each supports the others,” said COP31 president Murat Kurum, who is also Turkiye's environment minister.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — प्रत्येक दूसरे का समर्थन करता है, ”COP31 के अध्यक्ष मूरत कुरुम ने कहा, जो तुर्किये के पर्यावरण मंत्री भी हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: “We want people to feel the results of climate talks in daily life: in buildings that use less energy, in clean public transport, in energy they can afford and in new jobs.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — "हम चाहते हैं कि लोग दैनिक जीवन में जलवायु वार्ता के परिणामों को महसूस करें: इमारतों में जो कम ऊर्जा का उपयोग करते हैं, स्वच्छ सार्वजनिक परिवहन में, ऊर्जा में जो वे खर्च कर सकते हैं और नई नौकरियों में।"।

hinglishTracks.en: Environmental activists note that the pledge does not require that electricity must come from renewable sources, meaning coal and other fossil fuels could be used.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — पर्यावरण कार्यकर्ताओं का कहना है कि प्रतिज्ञा में यह आवश्यक नहीं है कि बिजली नवीकरणीय स्रोतों से आनी चाहिए, जिसका अर्थ है कि कोयला और अन्य जीवाश्म ईंधन का उपयोग किया जा सकता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: But as countries try to move away from fossil fuels, renewable energy is expected to play a major role.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — लेकिन जैसे-जैसे देश जीवाश्म ईंधन से दूर जाने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं, नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा द्वारा एक प्रमुख भूमिका निभाने की उम्मीद है।।

hinglishTracks.en: From Indonesia to Brazil, the boom in demand for the metals and minerals needed to create wind turbines, solar panels, electric vehicle batteries, high-speed railways and other technologies crucial for the renewable energy transition has been underway for some time, according to the International Energy Agency.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अंतर्राष्ट्रीय ऊर्जा एजेंसी के अनुसार, इंडोनेशिया से ब्राजील तक, पवन टरबाइन, सौर पैनल, इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन बैटरी, हाई-स्पीड रेलवे और नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा संक्रमण के लिए महत्वपूर्ण अन्य प्रौद्योगिकियों को बनाने के लिए आवश्यक धातुओं और खनिजों की मांग में उछाल कुछ समय से चल रहा है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Electrification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: विद्युतीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Electrification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 UN climate summit pushes electrification goal as groups call for mining safeguards

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 08:20:37 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The pledge builds on commitments made at previous UN climate summits: At COP28, countries agreed to work toward tripling renewable energy capacity and transitioning away from fossil fuels. COP29 focused on energy storage, grid modernisation and climate finance

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Clean public transport, energy-efficient buildings and affordable energy are a few of the things the president of the UN climate talks — known as COP31 — asked global leaders and climate activists to pledge as part of the global electrification plan laid out during the world's largest annual climate summit. But environmental and human rights organisations caution that without strong safeguards, the mining boom for the minerals and metals needed to make the power lines, batteries, wind turbines and other energy infrastructure that can make the pledge a reality could have serious environmental and human rights impacts across the globe. Mining has come at a cost to communities and habitats around the globe: Forests have been felled, water supplies poisoned and Indigenous peoples have lost access to land. Rights groups have urged COP31 officials to focus on how to fairly source the materials needed for the transition. Turkiye announced that electrification would be one of the main priorities during its copresidency of COP31 with Australia. The “35-by-35” global electrification pledge aims to increase the use of electricity from 21% to 35% by 2035 to reduce planet-warming greenhouse emissions, preferably from renewable energy such as solar and wind. The pledge builds on commitments made at previous UN climate summits: At COP28 , countries agreed to work toward tripling renewable energy capacity and transitioning away from fossil fuels. COP29 focused on energy storage, grid modernisation and climate finance. The COP31 presidency said electrification is the next logical step, translating earlier pledges into changes in how energy is consumed. “This transition brings together renewable energy, strong grids, storage capacity, energy efficiency, clean transport and green industry. Each supports the others,” said COP31 president Murat Kurum, who is also Turkiye's environment minister. “We want people to feel the results of climate talks in daily life: in buildings that use less energy, in clean public transport, in energy they can afford and in new jobs.” Environmental activists note that the pledge does not require that electricity must come from renewable sources, meaning coal and other fossil fuels could be used. But as countries try to move away from fossil fuels, renewable energy is expected to play a major role.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: From Indonesia to Brazil, the boom in demand for the metals and minerals needed to create wind turbines, solar panels, electric vehicle batteries, high-speed railways and other technologies crucial for the renewable energy transition has been underway for some time, according to the International Energy Agency.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Indigenous (Adjective)
स्वदेशी — अपने ही देश (भारत) के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों द्वारा देश में विकसित किया गया।
✓ Syn: Domestic, Home-grown, Native  |  ✖ Ant: Imported, Foreign, Exotic
Electrification (Noun)
विद्युतीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Electrification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Modernisation (Noun)
आधुनिकीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Modernisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "UN climate summit pushes electrification goal as groups call for mining safeguards", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The pledge builds on commitments made at previous UN climate summits: At COP28, countries agreed to work toward tripling renewable energy capacity...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'UN climate summit pushes electrification goal as' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'UN climate summit pushes electrification goal' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'UN climate summit pushes electrification goal' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The pledge builds on commitments made at previous UN climate summits: At COP28, countries agreed to work toward tripling renewable energy capacity..." (Hinglish Arth: यह प्रतिज्ञा पिछले संयुक्त राष्ट्र जलवायु शिखर सम्मेलन में की गई प्रतिबद्धताओं पर आधारित है: COP28 में, देशों ने नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा क्षमता को तीन गुना करने और जीवाश्म ईंधन से दूर जाने की दिशा में काम करने पर सहमति व्यक्त की।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "UN climate summit pushes electrification goal as groups call for mining safeguards"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. From Indonesia to Brazil, the boom in demand for the metals and minerals needed to create wind turbines, solar panels, electric vehicle batteries,...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "From Indonesia to Brazil, the boom in demand for the metals and minerals needed to create wind turbines, solar panels, electric vehicle batteries,..." (Hinglish Arth: इंडोनेशिया से ब्राजील तक, पवन टरबाइन, सौर पैनल, इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन बैटरी, हाई-स्पीड रेलवे और नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा के लिए महत्वपूर्ण अन्य प्रौद्योगिकियों को बनाने के लिए आवश्यक धातुओं और खनिजों की मांग में उछाल)

articles.title: Yemen’s Houthis say they targeted Saudi East-West pipeline, port city of Yanbu
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The East-West pipeline, which ends at Yanbu, has become increasingly important to Saudi Arabia, allowing it to get its oil to market after Iran blockaded the Strait of Hormuz on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Yemen's Houthis said on Thursday (November 12, 2026) that their forces targeted Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline and an oil facility in the port city of Yanbu on the Red Sea. The pipeline, which ends at Yanbu, has become increasingly important to the world's largest crude exporter, allowing it to get its oil to market after Iran blockaded the Strait of Hormuz on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula at the outset of the West Asia war. Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree said in a post on X that one operation "targeted Pumping Station No. 7 on the East-West Pipeline using a drone", while a second "targeted the Yanbu oil facility using a ballistic missile". He claimed both attacks — as well as two others launched at a Saudi airport and an airbase not far from the Yemeni border — had been successful. The Houthis have repeatedly targeted the East-West pipeline, and on Monday (November 9, 2026) Saudi Arabia said an attack on the conduit had sparked a fire but had not affected operations. Saree also said the Houthis had attacked state-run oil company Saudi Aramco in Riyadh with a drone, though there were no immediate reports of damage. A skyscraper belonging to the oil giant was hit on Sunday (November 8, 2026) by what authorities described as falling shrapnel from an "attempted attack". The Saudi-led coalition fighting the Houthis announced on Thursday (November 12, 2026) night of having intercepted a drone in the Riyadh area. It previously said it had knocked down several other missiles and drones from Wednesday (November 11, 2026) night through Thursday (November 12, 2026) morning, though it was unclear whether they were the ones mentioned by the Iran-backed group.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On Thursday (November 12, 2026) morning, the coalition, which backs Yemen's internationally recognised government, said it had intercepted a drone in the Riyadh region and another in Saudi Arabia's east.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Yemen’s Houthis say they targeted Saudi East-West pipeline, port city of Yanbu

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 07:43:52 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The East-West pipeline, which ends at Yanbu, has become increasingly important to Saudi Arabia, allowing it to get its oil to market after Iran blockaded the Strait of Hormuz on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Yemen's Houthis said on Thursday (November 12, 2026) that their forces targeted Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline and an oil facility in the port city of Yanbu on the Red Sea. The pipeline, which ends at Yanbu, has become increasingly important to the world's largest crude exporter, allowing it to get its oil to market after Iran blockaded the Strait of Hormuz on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula at the outset of the West Asia war. Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree said in a post on X that one operation "targeted Pumping Station No. 7 on the East-West Pipeline using a drone", while a second "targeted the Yanbu oil facility using a ballistic missile". He claimed both attacks — as well as two others launched at a Saudi airport and an airbase not far from the Yemeni border — had been successful. The Houthis have repeatedly targeted the East-West pipeline, and on Monday (November 9, 2026) Saudi Arabia said an attack on the conduit had sparked a fire but had not affected operations. Saree also said the Houthis had attacked state-run oil company Saudi Aramco in Riyadh with a drone, though there were no immediate reports of damage. A skyscraper belonging to the oil giant was hit on Sunday (November 8, 2026) by what authorities described as falling shrapnel from an "attempted attack". The Saudi-led coalition fighting the Houthis announced on Thursday (November 12, 2026) night of having intercepted a drone in the Riyadh area. It previously said it had knocked down several other missiles and drones from Wednesday (November 11, 2026) night through Thursday (November 12, 2026) morning, though it was unclear whether they were the ones mentioned by the Iran-backed group.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On Thursday (November 12, 2026) morning, the coalition, which backs Yemen's internationally recognised government, said it had intercepted a drone in the Riyadh region and another in Saudi Arabia's east.

D. The author contends that 'Yemen’s Houthis say they targeted Saudi East-' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The East-West pipeline, which ends at Yanbu, has become increasingly important to Saudi Arabia, allowing it to get its oil to market after Iran..." D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: U.S., Ukraine say Europe to join Russia talks as Putin sticks to hardline stance
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: U.S. envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff held over four hours of talks with Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin before jetting to debrief Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Dublin

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and U.S. envoy Jared Kushner said Thursday (November 12, 2026) Europe would join the next round of talks with Russia, as Vladimir Putin indicated Moscow will not compromise on its hardline demands to end almost five years of war. In a packed day of shuttle diplomacy following negotiations in Abu Dhabi, Mr. Kushner and fellow envoy Steve Witkoff held over four hours of talks with Mr. Putin in the Kremlin before jetting to debrief Mr. Zelenskyy in Dublin. As they spoke to journalists on the tarmac of a military airbase in Ireland, the main piece of progress touted by the Ukrainian leader and U.S. President Donald Trump's representative was that European negotiators would be at the table for future talks. Mr. Zelenskyy said Europeans will take part rather than remain "separately" on the sidelines as they were in Abu Dhabi, insisting: "They will have a voice". Mr. Kushner later reiterated the sentiment in a post on X, writing: "Both sides have now agreed to expand the next round of negotiations to include our European partners." "Significant differences remain, but we are encouraged by the progress made," he posted, adding that the schedule and details on the negotiating track would be released "shortly". An EU official told AFP representatives of five European capitals as well as the European Commission that the U.S. envoys, and that a new multilateral meeting "will be fixed soon". The Kremlin did not confirm Mr. Putin had agreed to include Europe in future talks, which Kyiv and its allies have long been seeking. Instead, the Russian leader had earlier told the U.S. duo he would not water down demands to control parts of Ukraine that Russia claims to have annexed and ruled out agreeing to foreign peacekeeping troops in Ukraine -- a deployment he said would be a "continuation of war".
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: As the United States has pushed for Europe to be allowed at the table, Moscow has sought to reframe talks as part of a wider discussion about European security.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 U.S., Ukraine say Europe to join Russia talks as Putin sticks to hardline stance

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 08:58:43 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: U.S. envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff held over four hours of talks with Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin before jetting to debrief Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Dublin

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and U.S. envoy Jared Kushner said Thursday (November 12, 2026) Europe would join the next round of talks with Russia, as Vladimir Putin indicated Moscow will not compromise on its hardline demands to end almost five years of war. In a packed day of shuttle diplomacy following negotiations in Abu Dhabi, Mr. Kushner and fellow envoy Steve Witkoff held over four hours of talks with Mr. Putin in the Kremlin before jetting to debrief Mr. Zelenskyy in Dublin. As they spoke to journalists on the tarmac of a military airbase in Ireland, the main piece of progress touted by the Ukrainian leader and U.S. President Donald Trump's representative was that European negotiators would be at the table for future talks. Mr. Zelenskyy said Europeans will take part rather than remain "separately" on the sidelines as they were in Abu Dhabi, insisting: "They will have a voice". Mr. Kushner later reiterated the sentiment in a post on X, writing: "Both sides have now agreed to expand the next round of negotiations to include our European partners." "Significant differences remain, but we are encouraged by the progress made," he posted, adding that the schedule and details on the negotiating track would be released "shortly". An EU official told AFP representatives of five European capitals as well as the European Commission that the U.S. envoys, and that a new multilateral meeting "will be fixed soon". The Kremlin did not confirm Mr. Putin had agreed to include Europe in future talks, which Kyiv and its allies have long been seeking. Instead, the Russian leader had earlier told the U.S. duo he would not water down demands to control parts of Ukraine that Russia claims to have annexed and ruled out agreeing to foreign peacekeeping troops in Ukraine -- a deployment he said would be a "continuation of war".

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: As the United States has pushed for Europe to be allowed at the table, Moscow has sought to reframe talks as part of a wider discussion about European security.

प्रतिनिधि — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Representative' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

विस्तार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Continuation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: U.S. envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff held over four hours of talks with Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin before jetting to debrief Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Dublin
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and U.S. envoy Jared Kushner said Thursday (November 12, 2026) Europe would join the next round of talks with Russia, as Vladimir Putin indicated Moscow will not compromise on its hardline demands to end almost five years of war. In a packed day of shuttle diplomacy following negotiations in Abu Dhabi, Mr. Kushner and fellow envoy Steve Witkoff held over four hours of talks with Mr. Putin in the Kremlin before jetting to debrief Mr. Zelenskyy in Dublin. As they spoke to journalists on the tarmac of a military airbase in Ireland, the main piece of progress touted by the Ukrainian leader and U.S. President Donald Trump's representative was that European negotiators would be at the table for future talks. Mr. Zelenskyy said Europeans will take part rather than remain "separately" on the sidelines as they were in Abu Dhabi, insisting: "They will have a voice". Mr. Kushner later reiterated the sentiment in a post on X, writing: "Both sides have now agreed to expand the next round of negotiations to include our European partners." "Significant differences remain, but we are encouraged by the progress made," he posted, adding that the schedule and details on the negotiating track would be released "shortly". An EU official told AFP representatives of five European capitals as well as the European Commission that the U.S. envoys, and that a new multilateral meeting "will be fixed soon". The Kremlin did not confirm Mr. Putin had agreed to include Europe in future talks, which Kyiv and its allies have long been seeking. Instead, the Russian leader had earlier told the U.S. duo he would not water down demands to control parts of Ukraine that Russia claims to have annexed and ruled out agreeing to foreign peacekeeping troops in Ukraine -- a deployment he said would be a "continuation of war".
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: As the United States has pushed for Europe to be allowed at the table, Moscow has sought to reframe talks as part of a wider discussion about European security.

articles.title: Centre sanctions new roads, infrastructure along China’s border
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Indo-Tibetan Border Police sanctions the construction of 15 pedestrian suspension bridges and 18 log bridges in Arunachal Pradesh; CCS clears 26 new roads as part of ICBR-III

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Amid continuing face-offs with the Chinese Army along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) in Arunachal Pradesh since late July, the Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) has sanctioned the construction of new border infrastructure in the northeastern State, a senior government official told The Hindu . Earlier, in February, the Cabinet Committee on Security (CCS) had cleared the third phase of the Indo-China Border Roads (ICBR-III) project. Under the scheme, as many as 26 roads are to be constructed along the LAC in Arunachal Pradesh, another government official said. The Union Government has not yet officially announced the ICBR-III project or publicly disclosed these details. This is only the second time after the 2020 Galwan clashes in eastern Ladakh that a critical road infrastructure project has been sanctioned along the border with China. The first phase of the ICBR was initiated in 2005 when it was decided that the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) would construct 27 priority roads with a total length of 608 km along the border with China. The second phase of the ICBR, comprising 32 roads with a total length of 683 km, was approved on September 21, 2020, just months after 20 Indian soldiers were killed in violent clashes with the Chinese People’s Liberation Army in eastern Ladakh. Since September, the ITBP has authorised the construction of 15 pedestrian suspension bridges and 18 log bridges in Upper Subansiri and Kurung Kumey districts, covering the areas bordering China in Arunachal Pradesh. The project clearance came days after India hosted the 18th BRICS Summit from September 11 to 13 in New Delhi, which was attended by Chinese President Xi Jinping. A government statement after the meeting said that Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasised that peace and tranquillity in the border areas remains an essential basis for the continued development of bilateral relations. He underlined the need for both sides to observe existing agreements and understandings on border-related issues. In December 2020, the MHA had approved construction of 18 pedestrian tracks, including foot suspension bridges, log bridges, and staging camps, measuring a total length of 598.27 km in the border areas of Arunachal Pradesh. On October 22 this year, former ITBP Director-General Shatrujeet Kapur mentioned that the “face-off” with Chinese troops “continues at several locations in Arunachal Pradesh.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Addressing the Himveer Samman Samaroah at the Central Training College at Alwar in Rajasthan, Mr. Kapur said: “In the past few days, a situation arose where face-offs happened at several locations in Arunachal and it still continues. Our Shaurya commandos played an exemplary role in this.”

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Centre sanctions new roads, infrastructure along China’s border

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 07:07:01 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Indo-Tibetan Border Police sanctions the construction of 15 pedestrian suspension bridges and 18 log bridges in Arunachal Pradesh; CCS clears 26 new roads as part of ICBR-III

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Amid continuing face-offs with the Chinese Army along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) in Arunachal Pradesh since late July, the Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) has sanctioned the construction of new border infrastructure in the northeastern State, a senior government official told The Hindu . Earlier, in February, the Cabinet Committee on Security (CCS) had cleared the third phase of the Indo-China Border Roads (ICBR-III) project. Under the scheme, as many as 26 roads are to be constructed along the LAC in Arunachal Pradesh, another government official said. The Union Government has not yet officially announced the ICBR-III project or publicly disclosed these details. This is only the second time after the 2020 Galwan clashes in eastern Ladakh that a critical road infrastructure project has been sanctioned along the border with China. The first phase of the ICBR was initiated in 2005 when it was decided that the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) would construct 27 priority roads with a total length of 608 km along the border with China. The second phase of the ICBR, comprising 32 roads with a total length of 683 km, was approved on September 21, 2020, just months after 20 Indian soldiers were killed in violent clashes with the Chinese People’s Liberation Army in eastern Ladakh. Since September, the ITBP has authorised the construction of 15 pedestrian suspension bridges and 18 log bridges in Upper Subansiri and Kurung Kumey districts, covering the areas bordering China in Arunachal Pradesh. The project clearance came days after India hosted the 18th BRICS Summit from September 11 to 13 in New Delhi, which was attended by Chinese President Xi Jinping. A government statement after the meeting said that Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasised that peace and tranquillity in the border areas remains an essential basis for the continued development of bilateral relations. He underlined the need for both sides to observe existing agreements and understandings on border-related issues. In December 2020, the MHA had approved construction of 18 pedestrian tracks, including foot suspension bridges, log bridges, and staging camps, measuring a total length of 598.27 km in the border areas of Arunachal Pradesh. On October 22 this year, former ITBP Director-General Shatrujeet Kapur mentioned that the “face-off” with Chinese troops “continues at several locations in Arunachal Pradesh.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Addressing the Himveer Samman Samaroah at the Central Training College at Alwar in Rajasthan, Mr. Kapur said: “In the past few days, a situation arose where face-offs happened at several locations in Arunachal and it still continues. Our Shaurya commandos played an exemplary role in this.”

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Development' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "Centre sanctions new roads, infrastructure along China’s border", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The Indo-Tibetan Border Police sanctions the construction of 15 pedestrian suspension bridges and 18 log bridges in Arunachal Pradesh; CCS clears 26...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Centre sanctions new roads, infrastructure along' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Centre sanctions new roads, infrastructure al' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Centre sanctions new roads, infrastructure al' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The Indo-Tibetan Border Police sanctions the construction of 15 pedestrian suspension bridges and 18 log bridges in Arunachal Pradesh; CCS clears 26..." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Centre sanctions new roads, infrastructure along China’s border"?

articles.title: Widespread outage hits Microsoft apps
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Microsoft said that a portion of its infrastructure was “experiencing elevated load” — which it said was “likely contributing to the connectivity errors”; it determined a number of servers were “unexpectedly unavailable” due to a problem that caused them to fail during automated checks

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A widespread outage hit Microsoft platforms including Outlook on Thursday (November 12, 2026), with many users encountering trouble using their email accounts and other errors across the tech giant's suite of apps. Nearly 1,30,000 users on outage tracker Downdetector reported problems accessing Outlook just after 1 p.m. ET. New reports have since fallen from that peak, but many said they couldn’t send and receive emails, or had trouble loading their inboxes altogether. Thousands also reported issues with Microsoft’s workplace messaging app Teams, as well as its AI assistant Copilot and wider Microsoft 365 services. Microsoft said that it was investigating disruptions, notably related to its email and Teams applications. In updates posted on social media, Redmond, Washington-based Microsoft said it was aware of users “experiencing issues accessing Exchange Online mailboxes through multiple connection methods in the Americas.” Microsoft later explained that a portion of its infrastructure was “experiencing elevated load” — which it said was “likely contributing to the connectivity errors.” The company determined a number of servers were “unexpectedly unavailable” due to a problem that caused them to fail during automated checks. Microsoft did not immediately provide more information around what might be causing that failure, but added that it was testing a fix. “We’re aggressively pursuing all pathways to reduce impact,” the Microsoft 365 Status account wrote on X. Earlier in the day, the company said it had “successfully restored” problems related to Microsoft Teams in North America, although some users continued to report connectivity issues.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: technology (general) / internet / communication infrastructure / science and technology

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Widespread outage hits Microsoft apps

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 07:16:34 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Microsoft said that a portion of its infrastructure was “experiencing elevated load” — which it said was “likely contributing to the connectivity errors”; it determined a number of servers were “unexpectedly unavailable” due to a problem that caused them to fail during automated checks

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A widespread outage hit Microsoft platforms including Outlook on Thursday (November 12, 2026), with many users encountering trouble using their email accounts and other errors across the tech giant's suite of apps. Nearly 1,30,000 users on outage tracker Downdetector reported problems accessing Outlook just after 1 p.m. ET. New reports have since fallen from that peak, but many said they couldn’t send and receive emails, or had trouble loading their inboxes altogether. Thousands also reported issues with Microsoft’s workplace messaging app Teams, as well as its AI assistant Copilot and wider Microsoft 365 services. Microsoft said that it was investigating disruptions, notably related to its email and Teams applications. In updates posted on social media, Redmond, Washington-based Microsoft said it was aware of users “experiencing issues accessing Exchange Online mailboxes through multiple connection methods in the Americas.” Microsoft later explained that a portion of its infrastructure was “experiencing elevated load” — which it said was “likely contributing to the connectivity errors.” The company determined a number of servers were “unexpectedly unavailable” due to a problem that caused them to fail during automated checks. Microsoft did not immediately provide more information around what might be causing that failure, but added that it was testing a fix. “We’re aggressively pursuing all pathways to reduce impact,” the Microsoft 365 Status account wrote on X. Earlier in the day, the company said it had “successfully restored” problems related to Microsoft Teams in North America, although some users continued to report connectivity issues.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: technology (general) / internet / communication infrastructure / science and technology

In updates posted on social media, Redmond, Washington-based Microsoft said it was aware of users “experiencing issues accessing Exchange Online mailboxes through multiple connection methods in the Americas.” Microsoft later explained that a portion of its infrastructure was “experiencing elevated load” — which it said was “likely contributing to the connectivity errors.” The company determined a number of servers were “unexpectedly unavailable” due to a problem that caused them to fail during automated checks. Microsoft did not immediately provide more information around what might be causing that failure, but added that it was testing a fix. “We’re aggressively pursuing all pathways to reduce impact,” the Microsoft 365 Status account wrote on X. Earlier in the day, the company said it had “successfully restored” problems related to Microsoft Teams in North America, although some users continued to report connectivity issues.
